title: Module script linking does not push realm execution context required in HostResolveImportedModule
body:
When running the <var>onFetchDescendantsComplete</var> algorithm in [fetch the descendants of and link a module script](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#fetch-the-descendants-of-and-link-a-module-script), JavaScript will (after calling the [Link ( )](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-moduledeclarationlinking) and [InnerModuleLinking ( module, stack, index )](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-InnerModuleLinking) steps) call back into the user agent using the [HostResolveImportedModule](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#hostresolveimportedmodule(referencingscriptormodule,-modulerequest)) host hook.

In step one

> <sub>[8.1.6.5.3 HostResolveImportedModule(referencingScriptOrModule, moduleRequest)](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#hostresolveimportedmodule(referencingscriptormodule,-modulerequest))</sub>
> 1. Let settings object be the [current settings object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#current-settings-object).

the hook obtains the [current settings object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#current-settings-object), which requires the [current realm](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#current-realm) to have an environment settings object in the [[[HostDefined]] field](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#concept-realm-settings-object).

[Running a module script](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#run-a-module-script) also calls into JavaScript (first [Evaluate ( )](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-moduleevaluation), then [InnerModuleEvaluation ( module, stack, index )](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-innermoduleevaluation)) to later run the host hook.

In this case however, the [script preparation steps](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#prepare-to-run-script) get run beforehand

> <sub>[8.1.4.4 Calling scripts, run a module script](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#run-a-module-script)</sub>
> 3. [Prepare to run script](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#prepare-to-run-script) given settings.

to ensure that the [current realm](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#current-realm) is the realm initialized with a settings object by either the [create a new browsing context](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#creating-a-new-browsing-context) or [create and initialize a Document object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#initialise-the-document-object) steps.

Not running the preparation steps (or pushing the [realm execution context](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#realm-execution-context) onto the execution context stack in general) when linking leads to the host hook not working properly.
